# GitHub Stats Artifacts

This directory contains generated GitHub statistics SVGs produced by the
`github-stats` workflow.

## Contents

| File | Description | Status |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `overview.svg` | Contribution overview | 🔲 Pending workflow run |
| `languages.svg` | Top programming languages | 🔲 Pending workflow run |
| `contributions.svg` | Contribution calendar | 🔲 Pending workflow run |

## Generation

Artifacts are generated by `.github/workflows/github-stats.yml` using
`lowlighter/metrics`. Run the workflow manually:

```sh
gh workflow run github-stats.yml
```

Or wait for the daily scheduled run (06:00 UTC).

## Notes

- Do not hand-edit files in this directory.
- Artifacts are committed by the workflow bot (`github-actions[bot]`).
- On API failure, existing artifacts are preserved unchanged.
